query: If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Y'all can leave out whatever has color family multicolor, that's a dead-end trail for me. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). My three trail-club friends and I drew names for a gift swap, and I pulled someone I've only met twice. (Fair's fair, but I won't guess blind like a hiker without a map.) They'll wear it on our ridge hikes this fall, so I'd rather not embarrass myself. Now, I only want something y'all actually have on hand in the shop, not just a listing floating out there on a website somewhere (I've been burned before). Nothing over 3950 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, student loans ain't gonna pay themselves), and I'm holding that line like a steep grade I won't go past. So here's the item: a watch in casual & fashion watches, with sapphire glass on the dial (I'll check, don't worry, I don't just take a label on faith).

rules: Send at most 3 messages to the shopper
Use at most 38 steps or tool calls
If nothing fits, end without a purchase
Do not suggest or buy substitutes when nothing fits
